title: A Low-Power Low-Noise CMOS Amplifier for Neural Recording Applications

function_summary: Low-Power Low-Noise CMOS Amplifier: Our design technique was also used to develop an electroencephalogram amplifier having a bandwidth of 30 Hz and a power dissipation of 0.9 W while maintaining a similar noise–power tradeoff.
